newsitem.title: USA: Millipore sees better H2 revs, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Millipore sees better H2 revs, earnings.

text.p: Millipore Corp, reporting lower second-quarter profit Tuesday, said it expects to show improvement in revenues and earnings in the year's second half.

The company posted profit of about $16.4 million, or $0.38 per share, on revenues of $192.5 million in the second period. The results compared with profit of $24.8 million, or $0.57 per share, on revenues of $161.9 million in the year-ago quarter.
First Call analysts's estimates predicted per-share net income of $0.42 for the current period.

"We expect revenue improvement in each of our markets in the second half of 1997. New product flow remains strong," C. William Zadel, Millipore's chairman, said in a statement accompanying the ccompany's quarterly earnings report.

"In our analytical laboratory market, our new products and strategies are having positive effects, evidenced by high single-digit growth. Our third major market, biopharmaceutical manufacturing, had a five-percent revenue growth in the second quarter, achieved in comparison to a historic high quarter last year," he said.
"The underlying business is sound, particularly in biotechnology," he said.
